setup.title: RACING
howto.1.title: Set up the series
howto.1.body: Pick the tracks in the order you want to drive them, then how many races and how many laps.
howto.2.title: Drive
howto.2.body: Turn the controller like a wheel to steer, and tilt it forward to accelerate.
howto.3.title: Win the series
howto.3.body: Every race pays points by finishing place. Whoever leads after the last one takes the series.
